title: Anthropic设立公益产品 治理透明度受关注
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So pre-IPO and Thropic announced that it was establishing a public benefit fund, which will commit a portion of Anthropics shares to the public good.
segments.zh: 所以Pre-IPO和Thropic宣布设立一个公共利益基金，将把一部分Anthropic股份投入公益事业。

segments.en: It's structured as an LLC, not a 501C3.
segments.zh: 它的结构是有限责任公司，而不是501C3非营利组织。

segments.en: So what do you see as the benefits and the drawbacks of this kind of approach?
segments.zh: 那么你认为这种方式的优点和缺点是什么？

segments.en: And how are you thinking about this public benefit fund? Yeah, I mean, I think I probably see more drawbacks than benefits to this particular structure. I would love to see a structure that had more transparency,
segments.zh: 你如何看待这个公共利益基金？嗯，我觉得对于这个特定结构，我看到的缺点可能多于优点。我希望看到一个更透明的结构，

segments.en: more separation from the company and the opportunity to bring into the governance structure, people who really know something about philanthropy and non-profits.
segments.zh: 与公司更分离，并有机会将真正了解慈善和非营利领域的人纳入治理结构。

segments.en: We'll see. Foundations have certain transparency requirements that an LLC would not.
segments.zh: 我们拭目以待。基金会有一定的透明度要求，而有限责任公司则没有。

segments.en: I think it would be a more powerful statement to have folks in a governance structure, whether it be a foundation board or whatever, whatever their particular entity,
segments.zh: 我认为，让那些不仅仅与公司有关联的人进入治理结构——无论是基金会董事会还是其他特定实体——会是一个更有力的声明。

segments.en: who did not, who weren't just connected to the company, I think that separation would be helpful and healthy. So that's what I would hope to see over time.
segments.zh: 这种分离将是有益和健康的。这就是我希望随着时间推移能看到的情况。
